# Introduction {.unnumbered}

This session covers algorithmic fairness in two parts. The first introduces the core concepts: how automated decision-making systems can disadvantage groups of people, where bias in data comes from, and the main formal notions of fairness and the trade-offs between them. The second presents recent research on how choices made throughout the machine learning pipeline affect fairness, and what this means for practice.
